basic.title: Basic Options
basic.description: Choose which of Home Assistant's standard presets to expose. Eco is turned on from the Home & Eco screen, where the peak settings that depend on it live. This entry wraps {source}; that cannot be changed here — delete the entry and add a new one to wrap a different entity.

comfort.title: Home & Eco
comfort.description:
Home is the everyday comfort band. Eco is the band used when you want the unit to work less.

Turn on "Use Eco during peak hours" and Home will quietly apply the Eco band inside the peak window, then go back to the Home band when peak ends — the preset still reads Home the whole time. Choosing Eco yourself holds Eco until you change it, peak or not.

The peak window applies every day and may run past midnight. Adjusting the thermostat by hand clears the preset and stops the substitution until you pick a preset again.

data_description.eco_enabled: Adds Eco to the preset picker. Required for peak substitution.

data_description.eco_mode: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the HVAC mode.
data_description.peak_end: An end earlier than the start means the window runs overnight.
